text:
Maya (CS): Heads up — noticed a 45% drop in daily active seats for AtlasHealth over the last 7 days. New procurement contact (Elsa) showed up in the last invoice loop. Can we triage?
Ravi (AM): ugh. timeline? did usage decline before or after Elsa appeared?
Maya (CS): drop starts ~2026-03-12, Elsa first email 2026-03-14 per notes.
Jonas (Solutions): any errors in logs or a stuck onboarding job? I can run a quick query.
Maya (CS): no incident on our side. most seat churn concentrated in the analytics team seats (50 users).
Priya (RevOps): flagging procurement. Elsa requested cost breakdowns and a performance benchmark vs competitor X last week.
Ravi (AM): ok — sounds like competitive eval + stakeholder switch. Maya, can you DM Elsa to get current evaluation criteria? I'll offer a focused benchmark call.
Maya (CS): pinged Elsa just now: "We're evaluating latency at 95th pct over 1M tokens + model cost per 1k tokens" and asked for timeline.
Jonas (Solutions): I can produce a short perf packet: 95th pct lat by route, suggested batching and quant profiles, expected cost delta vs competitor X. Need access to their sample prompts.
Ravi (AM): Maya — can you ask for a 1-page sample prompt set? If they share, Jonas and I will prep a 30-min runbook/demo.
Maya (CS): asked. Elsa replied: "will share by EOD. procurement wants written response by Fri."
Priya (RevOps): I'll prepare a concise cost sheet. Quick ask: do we have recent usage breakdown?
Maya (CS): attaching quick SQL output snippet:```sql
SELECT date, active_seats, tokens_consumed
FROM customer_usage
WHERE account = 'atlashealth'
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 14;
-- shows sharp drop on 2026-03-12
```
Jonas (Solutions): thanks. I'll run local sims against their sample prompts once they arrive. Also propose a fallback offer: 2-week Dedicated trial at discounted rate + SLA for the analytics route.
Ravi (AM): good offer. keep it gated: requires sharing prompt set and short call with their infra/analytics lead.
Maya (CS): noted. Elsa said procurement deadline Fri; I'll push for sample prompts today and schedule call.
Priya (RevOps): I'll draft the discount/terms and a one-pager to attach to the response.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Q1-benchmark-run job queued for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC (job id: 6fa7b3).
Jonas (Solutions): nice — I'll ensure the benchmark run includes 95th pct latency by model variant and also a quantized vs full float comparison.
Ravi (AM): action items recap: Maya — get prompts + schedule call; Jonas — prep perf packet & run benchmarks when prompts arrive; Priya — cost sheet + discount terms; I'll own customer call and negotiation.
Maya (CS): on it. I'll update this thread after the call scheduling. :thumbsup:
Ravi (AM): thanks team. if we don't get prompts by midday tomorrow, I'll escalate to Elsa's manager.
Maya (CS): copy that. filing a support note to track the procurement deadline in the account timeline.
Jonas (Solutions): FYI if we need a rapid fallback demo, I can spin a sandbox with a pinned model and pre-configured KV cache to show latency wins.
Priya (RevOps): sending draft cost sheet to the thread in 30.
Maya (CS): thread update 2026-03-15 09:12 — Elsa just shared the prompt set. scheduling for 2026-03-16 15:00 PT.
Ravi (AM): great — lock it. I'll invite sales-engineer and procurement lead.
Maya (CS): meeting invite sent. closing loop here until after the call.
Ravi (AM): :ear: post-call we'll capture commitments and an action plan to prevent churn.
Maya (CS): thanks all.
